note: One critic (the criticPrompt of scripts/workflows/lesson-drafts.js, with the tiger example replaced by the author's rejection of it) on the five rewrites taken on 2026-09-25.

scores.text:
Stood on a tiger's
tail. Not bitten.
scores.feedback: The Judgment says exactly this, the tiger picture is concrete, and it adds to the short's "mind how you step". The only weak spot is the line break: "tiger's / tail" splits across the two screen lines. "On a tiger's tail.\nIt does not bite." breaks cleanly.

scores.text:
Parted, they weep.
Met, they laugh.
scores.feedback: Concrete, human and true to line 5, but "Parted" is an inference (the text says weeping, then laughter when the armies meet) and "Met, they laugh." reads clipped. Plainer: "Apart, they weep.\nThey meet: laughter."

"The light returns" is a metaphor the book doesn't use (the Image has thunder under the earth, not light), and "Rest" repeats the meaning line "Rest. Only rushing stops it." Use the Image's detail, "Midwinter: gates\nshut, no travel.", or line 1, "Best return: from\nnot far away."
The squirrel is a good concrete image, but "Seen." is terse enough to read as cryptic. Try "Sneak ahead like\na squirrel: seen."

scores.text:
Lake gone dry?
Hold to your aim.
scores.feedback: "Hold to your aim" nearly repeats the short's meaning line "hold your purpose", and is weaker than the text's "stake your life". Switch to line 4, "Stuck in a gold\ncarriage. It ends.", or line 6.
